use rolify_core::role::RoleName;
use std::fmt;

/// Role model for the `{role_name}` entity.
///
/// Generated by `rolify-cli generate --backend mongodb {role_name} {holder_name}`.
/// MongoDB uses explicit null (Option) for scopeless roles (D-07), never the
/// SQL `''` sentinel.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct {role_name} {
    /// Unique identifier.
    pub id: String,

    /// Role name (byte-exact, case-sensitive).
    pub name: String,

    /// Resource type for scoped roles (None for global roles).
    pub resource_type: Option<String>,

    /// Resource ID for scoped roles (None for global roles).
    pub resource_id: Option<String>,
}

impl {role_name} {
    /// Creates a new global role.
    pub fn global(name: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: String::new(),
            name: name.into(),
            resource_type: None,
            resource_id: None,
        }
    }

    /// Creates a new class-scoped role.
    pub fn class(name: impl Into<String>, resource_type: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: String::new(),
            name: name.into(),
            resource_type: Some(resource_type.into()),
            resource_id: None,
        }
    }

    /// Creates a new instance-scoped role.
    pub fn instance(
        name: impl Into<String>,
        resource_type: impl Into<String>,
        resource_id: impl Into<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: String::new(),
            name: name.into(),
            resource_type: Some(resource_type.into()),
            resource_id: Some(resource_id.into()),
        }
    }

    /// Returns the role name as a `RoleName`.
    pub fn role_name(&self) -> RoleName {
        RoleName::from(self.name.clone())
    }

    /// Checks if this is a global role.
    pub fn is_global(&self) -> bool {
        self.resource_type.is_none() && self.resource_id.is_none()
    }

    /// Checks if this is a class-scoped role.
    pub fn is_class(&self) -> bool {
        self.resource_type.is_some() && self.resource_id.is_none()
    }

    /// Checks if this is an instance-scoped role.
    pub fn is_instance(&self) -> bool {
        self.resource_type.is_some() && self.resource_id.is_some()
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for {role_name} {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match (&self.resource_type, &self.resource_id) {
            (None, _) => write!(f, "{}", self.name),
            (Some(rt), None) => write!(f, "{} ({})", self.name, rt),
            (Some(rt), Some(rid)) => write!(f, "{} ({}: {})", self.name, rt, rid),
        }
    }
}
